observation.visible_scene: A man in a dark long-sleeved top, filmed from a low angle against a clear blue sky, juggles several red-white-and-blue basketballs (marked 'Baden' / 'GLOBETROTTERS' with star patterns). His head is tilted upward throughout, tracking the balls. Some balls are airborne while others rest in or are released by his outstretched hands.
visible_changes: The airborne balls continuously rise and fall along arcing paths, shifting their relative positions across the sky from frame to frame.
The man's hands alternately open to receive a descending ball and push upward to throw it, with his arms moving between a low cradling pose and a raised throwing pose.
The ball held in his extended hand (screen right) is repeatedly caught, held briefly, and tossed, while the opposite hand (screen left, lower) likewise receives and releases balls.
The set of balls in flight changes count and arrangement as the juggling cycle proceeds, with some balls passing near the top edge of the frame.
The man's gaze and head orientation remain fixed upward, following the moving balls.
outside_clip_unknowns: The beginning and end of the juggling routine are not shown; the excerpt is a mid-action slice.
The total number of balls used in the full routine and any subsequent tricks or drops are unknown.
Whether the camera drifts slightly or is fully locked is not determinable from the static sky background alone.
uncertain_details: Exact ball count in continuous rotation is hard to fix because balls overlap and exit the top of the frame.
Minor apparent shifts in framing could be camera movement or the man's body sway; background evidence is insufficient to separate them.
